title: The Little Prince – level 1
paragraphs: The Little Prince is a famous book. It is a book by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry. Now, you can listen to the story of the little prince. You can listen at www.thelittleprinceinlevels.com. The book is in three levels.
You can send this book to your friends.
We hope that you like the book. The book is from the year 1943. The book is one of the best books in history.
